sections.extract: Research Routine HIV testing in Ugandan hospitals Among couples who were tested, 100% of the HIV-negative members of discor- dant couples were previously unaware of their discordant status. These find- ings highlight the need to promote HIV testing for couples. Offering HCT to patients attending hospital saved them both time and transport expenses.
